items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: And then I worked the entertainers down here with Billy O'Connor.

ctx.x: And then I worked the entertainers down here with Billy O'Connor. We went in there, Pessie Jones, myself, Roy Evans. It had a pretty nice little outfit in there.
Yeah, that was on the one up here on the Crozat Street or Franklin Street they used to call it. Yes. I remember the building but I never did get in there before then.
